Needs changes before merge. Two blocking findings. The recommended label is `needs-rework`.
I left the labels, title and draft state unchanged, as required for this review.

I read the complete diff and checked the laws from upstream main `ec314174e3afe7d88524c6cecb4b4afe871dd65d`.
There is no earlier review. This is a safety-tier review because the change affects geometric recognition and operation selection.
The trial merge is `6abd3ff174f8513cc101610a5259fdc9f49b2131`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4320`. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:

1. **A recess can hide a boss from the slot check.** [crates/app/src/recognize/walls.rs:182](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/80b8089282a4314ff3c70eb5c70603fc75719bce/crates/app/src/recognize/walls.rs#L182)

   `rises_from` checks only facets that share an edge with the floor's inner ring.
   Those facets can descend into a recess that surrounds a taller boss.
   The check then returns false, although the boss obstructs the slot cut.

   I reproduced this with the existing `height_field` and MCP `job` helpers:

   ```rust
   let xs = [-30.0, -6.0, -3.0, 3.0, 6.0, 30.0];
   let ys = [-20.0, -5.0, -3.0, -1.0, 1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 20.0];
   let mesh = height_field(&xs, &ys, |i, j| {
       if i == 2 && j == 3 { 15.0 }
       else if (1..=3).contains(&i) && (2..=4).contains(&j) { 2.0 }
       else if (1..=5).contains(&j) { 10.0 }
       else { 20.0 }
   });
   ```

   The slot floor is at z 10. A 12 x 6 mm recess surrounds a 6 x 2 mm boss whose top is at z 15.
   On bare upstream main, the floor reads as `open_pocket`. On this PR, it reads as `slot`.
   `create` makes `Slot1`, and `generate` reports `status: ok`.
   Verification correctly detects the gouge. Posting also refuses the program:

   ```text
   post: post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 96 cell(s), worst 5.00 mm at (-2.69, -0.94, z 10.00)
   ```

   The local regression test rejects this slot classification. It fails on the PR and passes on bare upstream main.
   Check for material above the floor throughout each excluded inner region before accepting a Slot.
   Add a test for this nested recess and boss. The adjacent-wall boss test does not cover this case.

2. **Move the new geometry algorithm to its owning crate.** [crates/app/src/recognize/pinch.rs:15](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/80b8089282a4314ff3c70eb5c70603fc75719bce/crates/app/src/recognize/pinch.rs#L15)

   This new module operates on mesh boundaries, feature loops, polygon areas and point containment.
   It does not read or write the ECS world, a project file, a command, MCP or the CLI.
   It violates upstream AGENTS.md, Code shape: **`app` holds the document, nothing else.**
   Put the ring proof in the geometry crate and call its API from the document reader.
   The recovery API can return rings without changing the shared feature walk or saved `FaceId` values.
